name: Noctis Umbra
source:
Trying to find a place for herself in a completely new world, a starving Nocturnal struggles to choose a side.

Will you fight or run away from the battle between the light and the darkness?

[From [url=https://rinmarugames.tumblr.com/NoctisUmbra]the developer's Tumblr[/url]]
